title: "Deeply sorry for disruption": Microsoft issues apology after global outage, says "broad recovery" across services
description: In a statement posted on X, Microsoft said the disruption was caused by a technical issue linked to an earlier network capacity upgrade, which surfaced following a recent network change. The company clarified that the incident was not related to a cyberattack or artificial intelligence (AI) agents.

title: On Day 2 of massive Outlook outage, Microsoft moves toward recovery
description: As an outage that affected Outlook email inboxes and other Microsoft services across the globe entered a second day, the company said it was seeing encouraging progress toward a stable restoration. After a day of online jokes and speculation around the massive disruption, Microsoft said Friday morning that there were no signs that a cyberattack or rogue artificial intelligence agents were to blame
